result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner text has critically low contrast and is barely readable against the light background.

issues.description: The promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout 3 min. order  10' use white text on a very light mint-green background, making the text barely legible with very low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast to meet WCAG AA: use dark green text on the light background or darken the banner background if keeping white text.
